hook_en: God is the strength of your heart. 🙏
reflect_en: Asaph admitted that his flesh and his heart may fail, but he didn't stop there: God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever. Whatever feels like it's giving out this Tuesday, you are guided by His counsel and held by a strength that doesn't run out.
q_en: Where do you need God to be your strength today?
x_en: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

yt_title: God Is the Strength of My Heart | Psalm 73:24–26 #Shorts
li_open: Every leader eventually runs out of their own strength.
li_quote: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
li_body: Asaph was honest that his own heart could fail, and he found his strength and his portion in God instead. Leaders who draw on God's strength in prayer, and care for the people who are running low around them, can serve faithfully long after their own reserves are gone.
hook_es: Dios es la roca de tu corazón. 🙏
reflect_es: Asaf reconoció que su carne y su corazón desfallecían, pero no se quedó ahí: la roca de su corazón y su porción es Dios para siempre. Si hoy sientes que tus fuerzas se acaban, Él te guía según Su consejo y sigue siendo tu roca firme.
q_es: ¿En qué necesitas que Dios sea tu fuerza hoy?
x_es: Mi carne y mi corazón desfallecen: mas la roca de mi corazón y mi porción es Dios para siempre.
key_en: God is the strength of my heart
